1.4.3
• Own speed is passed to AutoTAK (ATAK keeps it outside the marker track), so the AutoTAK map can turn with the direction of travel.
• The event log notes whether ATAK supplies speed and course.

1.4.2
• Own plugin icon in the ATAK tools menu and plugin list.

1.4.1
• Build changes for distribution through Google Play (increasing build number, newer target Android level). No functional changes.

1.4
• An item selected in ATAK is reported to AutoTAK, which can move its map to it (a setting in the AutoTAK app, off by default).

1.3
• The panel shows the version of the connected AutoTAK app (for older apps: 2.1.0 or earlier).
• Event log with sharing as a file.
• Change history in the panel.

1.2
• Plugin panel with the link state, a settings summary and the buttons Settings and Force synchronization.
• Selecting an item as in ATAK: radial menu and information window.

1.1
• Settings page: reaction to a selection made in AutoTAK, all items or contacts only, switches for own data, icon sets, map definitions and the selected map name.
• English and Polish texts.

1.0
• First version: passes map items and their changes, own position and identity, the state of the server connection, icon sets and online map definitions to the AutoTAK app.
